units.source_text: 这个想法，忽然把他从女人清沙的声音，那奇怪的强制压迫感中解放了出来。

en.t: This idea suddenly freed him from the sound of the woman clearing away the sand, and from that strange sense of coercive pressure.

units.source_text: 水上行舟，沙上也该能行舟嘛。

en.t: If a boat can travel on water, then surely one ought to be able to travel over sand as well.

units.source_text: 如果摆脱房子的固定观念获得自由，那就没有必要浪费精力，去同沙子作无谓的争斗。

en.t: If he could free himself from the fixed idea of a house, there would be no need to waste his energy in a futile struggle against the sand.

units.source_text: 沙子上漂浮的、自由之船……流动的房子，无形的村镇……

en.t: A free boat floating on the sand... a moving house, an invisible village...
